'''Kung-Yee Liang''' ({{lang-zh|c=梁賡義|p=Liáng Gēng yí}}; born September 7, 1951<ref name="TWASFellows2012">{{cite web |title=Members Elected 2012 |url=http://twas.ictp.it/mbrs/members-by-year/members-elected-2012 |publisher=[[The World Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=November 10, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121003004833/http://twas.ictp.it/mbrs/members-by-year/members-elected-2012 |archive-date=October 3, 2012 |date=September 18, 2012 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=《人物專訪》難忘師恩 梁賡義力倡導師制 |url=https://news.ltn.com.tw/news/life/paper/436013 |access-date=November 10, 2025 |work=[[Liberty Times]] |date=October 17, 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251109231643/https://news.ltn.com.tw/news/life/paper/436013 |archive-date=November 9, 2025 |language=zh |url-status=live |trans-title=}}</ref>) is a Taiwanese biostatistician known for his work on [[generalized estimating equation]]s, which he introduced together with [[Scott Zeger]] in 1986.<ref name="gee1986">{{cite journal | journal=Biometrika | volume=73 | issue=1 | pages=13–22 | title=Longitudinal data analysis using generalized linear models | author1 = Kung-Yee Liang |author2-link=Scott Zeger | author2 = Scott Zeger | year=1986 | doi=10.1093/biomet/73.1.13| doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last1=Ziegler |first1=Andreas |title=Generalized estimating equations |date=2011 |publisher=Springer |location=New York |isbn=978-1-4614-0498-9 |page=vii}}</ref> He is a distinguished chair professor at [[Feng Chia University]] and the chairman of [[OBI Pharma, Inc.]]

From 1982 to 2010, Liang was a professor at the department of biostatistics at the [[Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health]]. In 2010, Liang returned to Taiwan, where he was the president of [[National Yang-Ming University]] from 2010 to 2017 and the president of the [[National Health Research Institutes]] from 2017 to 2022.

==Education and career==
Liang earned a bachelor's degree in mathematics from [[National Tsing Hua University]] in 1973 before coming to the U.S., where he received a master's degree in statistics from the [[University of South Carolina]] in 1979. In 1982, Liang completed his PhD in biostatistics at the [[University of Washington]] under the supervision of [[Norman Breslow]]. His dissertation was titled ''The Asymptotic Equivalence of Conditional and Unconditional Inference Procedures''.<ref name=mgp>{{mathgenealogy|id=47066}}. {{Retrieved|access-date=April 21, 2024}}</ref>

That same year, he joined the biostatistics department faculty at the [[Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health]] where he became a full professor in 1991 and stayed until he returned to Taiwan in 2010.<ref name="AcademiaSinicaCV" />

Returning to his home country, Liang moved from conducting research towards administrative and leadership roles. In August 2010, Liang became president of [[National Yang-Ming University]], a position he remained in until November 2017.<ref>{{cite web |title=People News for January 2010 |url=https://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2010/01/01/peoplenewsjan10/ |website=Amstat News |publisher=[[American Statistical Association]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |date=January 1, 2010 |quote=Liang will begin his appointment August 1.}}</ref>

From December 2017 to December 2022, he was the president of the [[National Health Research Institutes]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Dr. Kung-Yee Liang inaugurated as the President of NHRI |url=https://enews.nhri.edu.tw/en/dr-kung-yee-liang-inaugurated-as-the-president-of-nhri/ |website=NHRI Communications |publisher=[[National Health Research Institutes]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |date=March 6, 2018 |archive-date=April 24, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240424093919/https://enews.nhri.edu.tw/en/dr-kung-yee-liang-inaugurated-as-the-president-of-nhri/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="AcademiaSinicaCV" /> During his time as a vice president of the organisation (2003–2006), he had already served as the acting president of the organisation between January and June 2006.<ref>{{cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae |url=https://www.nhri.edu.tw/eng/About/more?id=004d2f47060a48199e4a3abad6642cab |publisher=[[National Health Research Institutes]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211022024747/https://www.nhri.edu.tw/eng/About/more?id=004d2f47060a48199e4a3abad6642cab |archive-date=October 22, 2021 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Distinguished Achievement Award 2011 |url=https://www.icsa.org/distinguished-achievement-award-2011/ |publisher=International Chinese Statistical Association |access-date=April 24, 2024 |archive-date=May 27, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230527051337/https://www.icsa.org/distinguished-achievement-award-2011/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Since February 2023, Liang has been Distinguished Chair Professor at [[Feng Chia University]].<ref>{{cite web |title=2023通識教育學會年會 逢甲大學梁賡義春雨講座主講「變局中的通識教育」 |url=https://www.fcu.edu.tw/news/2023032402/ |publisher=[[Feng Chia University]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |language=Chinese |date=March 24, 2023 |archive-date=September 24, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230924044524/https://www.fcu.edu.tw/news/2023032402/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="AcademiaSinicaCV" /><ref name="UWCareerLecture">{{cite web |title=Distinguished alumni Kung-Yee Liang visits UW |url=https://www.biostat.washington.edu/news/stories/distinguished-alumni-kung-yee-liang-visits-uw |website=Department of Biostatistics |publisher=[[University of Washington]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |date=April 16, 2024 |archive-date=April 24, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240424191530/https://www.biostat.washington.edu/news/stories/distinguished-alumni-kung-yee-liang-visits-uw |url-status=live }}</ref>

On December 29, 2023, he was elected as chairman of [[OBI Pharma, Inc.]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Kung-Yee Liang, PH.D. was elected as the chairman of OBI Pharma, Inc. |url=https://www.obipharma.com/news/kung-yee-liang-ph-d-was-elected-as-the-chairman-of-obi-pharma-inc/ |publisher=[[OBI Pharma, Inc.]] |access-date=April 23, 2024 |date=December 29, 2023 |archive-date=January 26, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240126202201/https://www.obipharma.com/news/kung-yee-liang-ph-d-was-elected-as-the-chairman-of-obi-pharma-inc/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Awards and recognition==
Liang has received multiple awards for his work, including the [[Snedecor Award]] from the [[Committee of Presidents of Statistical Societies]] in 1987,<ref>{{cite web |title=George W. Snedecor Award |url=https://community.amstat.org/copss/awards/snedecor |publisher=[[Committee of Presidents of Statistical Societies]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |archive-date=August 15, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180815201056/http://community.amstat.org/copss/awards/snedecor |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Snedecor Award: Past Award Recipients |url=http://nisla05.niss.org/copss/PastAwardsSnedecor.pdf |publisher=[[National Institute of Statistical Sciences]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150701092907/http://nisla05.niss.org/copss/PastAwardsSnedecor.pdf |archive-date=July 1, 2015 |url-status=dead}}</ref> the [[Rema Lapouse Award]] from the [[American Public Health Association]] in 2010,<ref>{{cite web |title=Kung-Yee Liang Recipient of 2010 Rema Lapouse Award |url=https://publichealth.jhu.edu/2010/liang-rema-lapouse-award |publisher=[[Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |date=August 17, 2010 |archive-date=November 20, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231120232155/https://publichealth.jhu.edu/2010/liang-rema-lapouse-award |url-status=live }}</ref> and the [[International Statistical Institute#Karl Pearson Prize|International Statistical Institute's Karl Pearson Prize]] in 2015.<ref>{{cite web |title=Former Karl Pearson Prize |url=https://isi-web.org/awards-prizes/former-karl-pearson-prize |publisher=[[International Statistical Institute]] |access-date=April 24, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=賀本院諮詢委員梁賡義院士榮獲「2015 年Karl Pearson獎」|trans-title=Academician Kung-Yee Liang receives 2015 Karl Pearson Prize |url=http://enews2.nhri.org.tw/enews_list_new2_more.php?volume_indx=623&showx=showarticle&article_indx=10740 |website=NHRI Communications |publisher=[[National Health Research Institutes]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |language=Chinese}}</ref> In 2025, he received the {{ill|Presidential Science Prize of Taiwan|zh|總統科學獎}}, the country's highest honor for scientific research.<ref>{{cite web |title=Feng Chia University Chun-Yu Chair Professor Kung-Yee Liang Receives Taiwan's Highest Scientific Research Honor: The 2025 Presidential Science Prize |url=https://www.fcu.edu.tw/en/news/2025100902/ |publisher=[[Feng Chia University]] |access-date=November 10, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251110002133/https://www.fcu.edu.tw/en/news/2025100902/ |archive-date=November 10, 2025 |date=October 9, 2025 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=「2024–2025年總統科學獎」得獎名單 |url=https://www.president.gov.tw/News/39520 |publisher=[[Office of the President (Taiwan)]] |access-date=November 10, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251110001559/https://www.president.gov.tw/NEWS/39520 |archive-date=November 10, 2025 |language=zh |date=October 8, 2025 |url-status=live |trans-title=Winners of the 2024–2025 Presidential Science Prize}}</ref>

In 1995, Liang was elected as a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/|title=ASA Fellows|publisher=[[American Statistical Association]]|access-date=April 22, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230927195138/https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/|archive-date=September 27, 2023|url-status=live}}</ref> He was elected as an academician of the [[Academia Sinica]] in 2002,<ref name="AcademiaSinicaCV">{{cite web |title=Academicians Directory: Kung-Yee Liang |url=https://academicians.sinica.edu.tw/index.php?r=academician-n%2Fshow&id=134&_lang=en |publisher=[[Academia Sinica]] |access-date=April 24, 2024 |archive-date=April 24, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240424082922/https://academicians.sinica.edu.tw/index.php?r=academician-n%2Fshow&id=134&_lang=en |url-status=live }}</ref> as a fellow of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] in 2012,<ref>{{cite web |title=Liang, Kung-Yee |url=https://twas.org/directory/liang-kung-yee |publisher=[[The World Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=November 10, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241115104305/https://www.twas.org/directory/liang-kung-yee |archive-date=November 15, 2024 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="TWASFellows2012" /> and as a member of the [[National Academy of Medicine]] in 2015.<ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Kung-Yee Liang |url=https://nam.edu/member/?member_id=8%2BkrfZCvx%2FxdR9b%2BV3o%2B1w%3D%3D |website=[[National Academy of Medicine]] |publisher=[[National Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=April 22, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240422145450/https://nam.edu/member/?member_id=8%2BkrfZCvx%2FxdR9b%2BV3o%2B1w%3D%3D |archive-date=April 22, 2024 |url-status=live}}</ref>
